modules.name: Provider-group rendering
modules.responsibility: Render the existing LIVE/SEED provider groups so the dashboard can list them separately without changing recovery or fetch topology.
modules.interface: Emit visible url-test groups with provider-scoped membership and unmodified source node names.
modules.seam: Generated YAML and Mihomo GET /proxies group fields and membership.

modules.name: Dashboard projection and controls
modules.responsibility: Project Mihomo policy groups and provider-scoped nodes into the installed Clash Party dashboard, including native pin/unpin actions.
modules.interface: List visible groups by default, open a group to inspect its member nodes, fix a chosen node, and clear the fixed choice.
modules.seam: Clash Party mihomoGroups default projection plus the actual installed dashboard and Mihomo fixed state.

interfaces.name: Visible provider-group profile
operations: render PROVIDER-AUTO-LIVE using only the LIVE provider
render PROVIDER-AUTO-SEED using only the SEED provider
leave both groups visible to default dashboard enumeration
interfaces.idempotency: The same render inputs preserve the same group names, provider scopes, group types, and recovery topology.

interfaces.name: Dashboard group selection
operations: list visible groups and resolve member nodes
pin a selected node in a url-test group
unpin the group to restore automatic selection
errors: group or node absent from the API projection
fixed selection not reflected by Mihomo
unpin does not resume automatic selection
interfaces.idempotency: Selecting the already fixed node leaves it fixed; clearing an absent fixed value leaves the automatic group unchanged.

transitions.event: User selects a node in the dashboard
transitions.guard: The selected node belongs to the opened LIVE or SEED group.
transitions.action: Mihomo records that node in fixed and keeps it selected despite url-test results.

transitions.event: User clears the pin in the dashboard
transitions.guard: The group is still type url-test.
transitions.action: Mihomo clears fixed and resumes url-test selection.

transitions.guard: The group has at least one eligible member.
transitions.action: Mihomo selects according to its automatic health-check behavior.

failure_handling.failure: Clash Party excludes a provider group from its default listing.
failure_handling.response: The renderer must not mark LIVE or SEED hidden; profile tests fail if it does.

failure_handling.failure: The API contains members but the installed dashboard does not show them.
failure_handling.response: Treat UI acceptance as failed and retain evidence distinguishing API support from UI discoverability.

failure_handling.failure: Pin/unpin is not available or does not transition fixed correctly in the installed UI.
failure_handling.response: Do not replace url-test with select or claim success; report the missing UI behavior for a separately scoped fix.
